audit.editing_archetype: Animated Parody Reenactment / Fast Multi-Clip Montage
audit.framing_9x16: Full vertical 9:16 custom hand-drawn and animated sequence adapting gameplay moments into high-energy cartoon narrative frames.
audit.subtitle_craft: Dynamic, bold cartoon font with dramatic size scaling on screams and panic audio, perfectly synced with vocal peaks.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Rapid dynamic push-ins and whipping camera pans matching the frantic pacing of the characters running from monsters.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Immersive sound effect layering (footsteps, heavy breathing, door slams) paired with high-tension comedic music building to frantic chases.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Flawless comedic pacing, building tension rapidly through slow reveals and explosive high-speed chases, culminating in punchy comedic cutaways.
standout_techniques: Transforming raw gameplay chaos into expressive hand-drawn 2D character animations with exaggerated panic expressions
Dynamic speed ramping on chase sequences to heighten comedic desperation
Synchronizing dramatic facial close-ups with vocal screams for maximum comedic impact
Using clean vertical framing to track fast-moving multi-tier facility escapes without losing subjects
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Letting frantic chase sequences become visually incomprehensible without clear directional framing
